value.rationale: Complete bipartite graphs are a canonical graph family immediately beyond the paper’s complete-graph and star benchmarks. The theorem replaces exponential subset search by a one-dimensional exact formula and reveals a genuine two-sided-placement phenomenon: at \(K_{10,10}\) with \((\lambda,	au)=(3/5,3/10)\), the unique optimal profile is \((3,3)\).
